NOTIFICATION FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF LIAISON
OFFICER
Notifi cation No. : E2 I 613l /2026/KPHCC/ADMN Date: 03-ll-2026
Applications are invited from eligible and interested candidates who were
retired from the service of Government preferably in Engineering
Departments/Public Sector undertakings for appointment to the post of Liaison
Officer in Kerala Police Housing & Constructi<in Corporation Ltd. (KPHCC),
Thiruvananthapuram, on the following terms and conditions.
1. Details of the Post
Particulars
Name of Post
Place of Posting
Method of appointmen : Direct Recruitment
Naturs of Appointment : Contract basis
Details
: Liaison Officer
: KPHCC Head Office, Thiruvananthapuram
: Rs.25410/ (Consolidated monthly remuneration)
: Below 62 years
Remuneration
Age Limit
2. Educational Qualification
. Degree from a recognised University.
3. Experience
. Minimum 20 years of service preferably in Government Engineering
Departments, Public Sector Undertakings or infrastructure/construction-
related organisations.
. Experience in dealing with Government Departments, statutory
authorities and Local Self Government Institutions will be preferred.
4. Duties and Responsibilities
l. Liaising with various Government Departments, Police Department,
PWD, LSGD and other statutory authorities.
2. Coordinating with Government officials for obtaining administrative
sanctions, technical sanctions, approvals and clearances for KPHCC
projects.
Following up on pending proposals, files and correspondence with
various Government Departments.
Assisting in the identification of new projects and business development
opportunities for KPHCC.
Maintaining effective coordination between' KPHCC Head Office,
District Project Engineers and external agencies.
Preparing periodic reports on liaison activities and the status of pending
matters.
7. Undertaking any other duties assigned by the Managing Director.
5. Mode of Selection
Selection will be made through scrutiny of applications followed by an
interview conducted by a selection committee constituted by the Corporation.
6. General Conditions
1. The appointment will be purely on a contract basis..
2. The selected candidate shall be willing to travel anywhere in Kerala in
connection with official duties.
3. The Corporation reserves the right to cancel or modify the notification or
not to fill the vacancy without assigning any reason.
4. Incomplete applications will be rejected.
5. The decision of the Managing Director regarding selection shall be final.
7. How to Apply
Interested candidates may submit their applications in the prescribed format,
along with copies of certificates proving educational qualifications and
experience, Copy of Pension Payment Order etc. to the Managing Director,
Kerala Police Housing & Construction Corporation Ltd., Thiruvananthapuram,
on or before II-|I-2026
